tools.name: search_msd_knowledge
tools.description: Search Primer International's global Market Systems Development (MSD / M4P) and Social Enterprise database (2,523 records across DCED, BEAM Exchange, MSD4E, SEWF, ILO The Lab, ANDE, WEF Schwab Foundation, and UN ESCAP).

tools.name: calculate_deal
tools.description: Calculate rural retail dealer unit economics, monthly working capital requirements, currency inflation decay, and smallholder payback periods for private sector co-investments.

tools.name: calculate_dced_attribution
tools.description: Calculate DCED-compliant attributable Net Additional Income (NAI), deadweight, displacement, substitution, systemic copycat crowding-in, and full-time equivalent (FTE) employment.

tools.name: lint_proposal
tools.description: Audit proposal text against core Market Systems Development (MSD) rules: detects direct asset handouts, missing partner matching funds, unadjusted 100% attribution claims, and vulnerable exchange rate pegs.
